name: fallworld
system: An installable browser game (a single-page app with no server) that shows the estate's public builds as cards and runs a deterministic rules engine on the visitor's own machine. Optional AI, all chosen by the visitor: a small open-weight model run in the visitor's own browser tab through WebLLM (weights download on the visitor's click; nothing is sent out), a model the visitor runs on their own machine (Ollama), or the visitor's own Anthropic or Google key used straight from their browser to that provider. The page collects nothing.
